name: Da-Cin Construction Co.,Ltd.
summary: Da-Cin Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the civil engineering and building construction in Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam. It operates through Engineering Department and Construction Department segments.
